 Shri S. G. Karmarkar, Advocate for applicant.
 Shri N. R. Rode, A. P. P. for respondent No.1.
 Shri Bhushan Sachdev, Advocate for respondent No.2.

Coram: Vinay Joshi And
 Valmiki Sa Menezes, Jj.

This is an application for quashing of Fir as well as charge sheet relating to the offence of rape on
account of settlement.
2.  It is submitted that the informant lady was major at the time of occurrence.
At the most, it is a case of consensus relationship and by the time, the parties have settled the matter and thus, it is a case for quashing of FIR.
The informant lady has appeared through Advocate Shri Bhushan Sachdev.
She is present in Court and identified by her Advocate Shri Bhushan Sachdev.
The informant is accompanied with her father - Khushrang Gajbhiye and maternal aunt - Namrata Dongre.
On enquiry, the informant girl stated about the settlement and her no objection to quash FIR.
She has also filed her reply- cum- no objection for quashing of FIR.
The record indicates that the date of birth of informant girl is as 01/07/2004 whilst alleged occurrence took place on 25/07/2022 meaning thereby, just within one month after her attaining majority.
Since the informant has just attained majority, prior to the date of occurrence, to satisfy ourselves whether she has consented for quashing of FIR by free will.
